_comment: Sibling mode sets (#564). 'system/light' and 'system/dark' are two top-level sets that are modes of 'system', so a token in one of them refers to a token of the SAME mode by the folded path ('{system.color.border.primary}'), which is what that alias means once the sets are read as modes. A bare 'system' group exists alongside them holding the mode-independent tokens, exactly as a real design system does — its presence is why the fold cannot be decided by asking whether the head segment is absent. The aliases below are the three outcomes: folded; declined because the path resolves only in the OTHER mode; declined because it resolves nowhere.

color.$description: CORRECT as authored: the folded path, resolvable in this token's own set.
BROKEN: 'border.onlyInDark' resolves in 'system/dark' but not in this token's own set, and no mode's value may stand in for another's.
CORRECT as authored, same as the light mode's.
BROKEN: resolves in no set, folded or not.
